"""Generate Figure 2: OVB Bias Scatter Plot.

Scatter plot of sequential θ̂ bias vs true contamination susceptibility c_n.
Shows that sequential estimation systematically overestimates ability for
models with high contamination susceptibility.
"""
import sys
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib import colormaps
from scipy import stats

DATA_PATH = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "fig2_permodel_data.csv"
OUT_DIR = "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-prod43/projects/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/figures/paper"

df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)

x_all = df["c_true"].values
y_all = df["bias"].values
r_all, p_all = stats.pearsonr(x_all, y_all)
print(f"All points: r={r_all:.4f}, p={p_all:.2e}, N={len(df)}")

# --- Figure ---
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.3, 3.3))

sc = ax.scatter(
    x_all, y_all,
    c=x_all, cmap="viridis",
    s=10, alpha=0.45, edgecolors="none", zorder=3,
)

# Regression line + 95% CI
x = x_all
y = y_all
slope, intercept, r_val, p_val, se = stats.linregress(x, y)
x_line = np.linspace(x.min() - 0.05, x.max() + 0.05, 200)
y_line = slope * x_line + intercept

# 95% CI for regression line
n = len(x)
x_mean = x.mean()
se_y = np.sqrt(np.sum((y - (slope * x + intercept))**2) / (n - 2))
se_line = se_y * np.sqrt(1.0 / n + (x_line - x_mean)**2 / np.sum((x - x_mean)**2))
t_crit = stats.t.ppf(0.975, n - 2)

ax.plot(x_line, y_line, color="black", linewidth=1.2, zorder=4)
ax.fill_between(
    x_line, y_line - t_crit * se_line, y_line + t_crit * se_line,
    color="gray", alpha=0.2, zorder=2,
)

# Zero line
ax.axhline(0, color="gray", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5, zorder=1)

# Annotation box: r and p-value (top-left)
p_str = f"$p$ < 0.001" if p_all < 0.001 else f"$p$ = {p_all:.3f}"
ann_text = f"$r$ = {r_all:.2f}, {p_str}"
ax.text(
    0.05, 0.95, ann_text, transform=ax.transAxes,
    fontsize=8, verticalalignment="top",
    bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.3", facecolor="white", alpha=0.8, edgecolor="0.7", linewidth=0.5),
)

# Data source annotation (bottom-right)
ax.text(
    0.95, 0.05, "Synthetic data\n($N$=50, $I$=100, $J$=8, 20 seeds)",
    transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=6.5, color="0.4",
    verticalalignment="bottom", horizontalalignment="right",
)

# Axis labels
ax.set_xlabel(r"True contamination susceptibility $c_n$", fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel(r"Sequential $\hat{\theta}$ bias ($\hat{\theta}_{\mathrm{seq}} - \theta_{\mathrm{true}}$)", fontsize=9)

# Tick styling
ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)

# Clean up spines
ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)

fig.tight_layout(pad=0.4)

# Save
pdf_path = f"{OUT_DIR}/fig2_ovb_bias.pdf"
png_path = f"{OUT_DIR}/fig2_ovb_bias.png"
fig.savefig(pdf_path, bbox_inches="tight", dpi=300)
fig.savefig(png_path, bbox_inches="tight", dpi=300)
plt.close(fig)

print(f"Saved: {pdf_path}")
print(f"Saved: {png_path}")

"""Generate Figure 3: Error Propagation Sensitivity.

Dual-panel plot showing θ-RMSE and c_n-RMSE as functions of exposure noise σ_e.
Demonstrates graceful degradation below σ_crit ≈ 0.2 and rapid nonlinear
degradation beyond, establishing a falsifiable applicability boundary.
"""
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

OUT_DIR = "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-prod43/projects/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/figures/paper"

# --- Data from exp-012 (20 seeds) ---
sigma = np.array([0.0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5])

theta_rmse_mean = np.array([0.1277, 0.1295, 0.1352, 0.1748])
theta_rmse_std = np.array([0.0178, 0.0178, 0.0175, 0.0266])

cn_rmse_mean = np.array([0.533, 0.5452, 0.5751, 0.8415])

# Theoretical predictions (approximate)
theta_theory = np.array([0.1277, 0.1295, 0.1352, 0.1749])
cn_theory = np.array([0.533, 0.5452, 0.5751, 0.8415])

# Dense grid for smooth theoretical curves
sigma_dense = np.linspace(0, 0.55, 200)
theta_theory_dense = np.interp(sigma_dense, sigma, theta_theory)
cn_theory_dense = np.interp(sigma_dense, sigma, cn_theory)

# Percentage degradation relative to baseline (σ=0)
theta_pct = (theta_rmse_mean - theta_rmse_mean[0]) / theta_rmse_mean[0] * 100
cn_pct = (cn_rmse_mean - cn_rmse_mean[0]) / cn_rmse_mean[0] * 100

SIGMA_CRIT = 0.2
BLUE = "#1f4e79"
GRAY = "#888888"

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(6.5, 3.0))

for ax, y_mean, y_std, y_theory, pct, ylabel, panel_label in [
    (ax1, theta_rmse_mean, theta_rmse_std, theta_theory_dense,
     theta_pct, r"$\theta$-RMSE", "(a)"),
    (ax2, cn_rmse_mean, None, cn_theory_dense,
     cn_pct, r"$c_n$-RMSE", "(b)"),
]:
    # Regime bands
    ax.axvspan(-0.02, SIGMA_CRIT, color="green", alpha=0.12, zorder=0)
    ax.axvspan(SIGMA_CRIT, 0.58, color="red", alpha=0.10, zorder=0)

    # σ_crit vertical line
    ax.axvline(SIGMA_CRIT, color="black", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.9, zorder=2)
    ax.text(SIGMA_CRIT + 0.01, ax.get_ylim()[0] if ax.get_ylim()[0] != 0 else 0.99,
            r"$\sigma_{\mathrm{crit}}$", fontsize=8, va="top",
            transform=ax.get_xaxis_transform(), ha="left")

    # Theoretical curve (dense smooth line)
    ax.plot(sigma_dense, y_theory, color=GRAY, linestyle="--", linewidth=1.0,
            label="Theoretical", zorder=3)

    # Empirical data
    if y_std is not None:
        ax.errorbar(sigma, y_mean, yerr=y_std, fmt="o-", color=BLUE,
                    markersize=5, linewidth=1.4, capsize=3, capthick=1.0,
                    label="Empirical (20 seeds)", zorder=5)
    else:
        ax.plot(sigma, y_mean, "o-", color=BLUE, markersize=5, linewidth=1.4,
                label="Empirical (20 seeds)", zorder=5)

    # Percentage degradation annotations
    for i in range(len(sigma)):
        if pct[i] == 0:
            continue
        offset_y = 8 if i < 3 else 10
        offset_x = 0
        if i == 1:
            offset_x = 5
        ax.annotate(
            f"+{pct[i]:.1f}%",
            xy=(sigma[i], y_mean[i]),
            xytext=(offset_x, offset_y),
            textcoords="offset points",
            fontsize=7, color="#b03030", fontweight="bold",
            ha="center", va="bottom",
        )

    ax.set_xlabel(r"Exposure noise $\sigma_e$", fontsize=9)
    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel, fontsize=9)
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)
    ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
    ax.set_xlim(-0.02, 0.55)

    # Panel label
    ax.text(0.03, 0.95, panel_label, transform=ax.transAxes,
            fontsize=10, fontweight="bold", va="top")

# Fix σ_crit label placement after axes limits are set
for ax in (ax1, ax2):
    ylim = ax.get_ylim()
    y_top = ylim[1] - (ylim[1] - ylim[0]) * 0.04
    # Remove old text and re-place
    for txt in ax.texts:
        if r"$\sigma_{\mathrm{crit}}$" in txt.get_text():
            txt.set_position((SIGMA_CRIT + 0.015, y_top))
            txt.set_transform(ax.transData)
            txt.set_va("top")
            txt.set_ha("left")

# Legend (shared, in panel a)
ax1.legend(fontsize=7, loc="lower right", framealpha=0.8,
           edgecolor="0.7", borderpad=0.4)

fig.tight_layout(w_pad=2.5, pad=0.4)

pdf_path = f"{OUT_DIR}/fig3_error_propagation.pdf"
png_path = f"{OUT_DIR}/fig3_error_propagation.png"
fig.savefig(pdf_path, bbox_inches="tight", dpi=300)
fig.savefig(png_path, bbox_inches="tight", dpi=300)
plt.close(fig)

print(f"Saved: {pdf_path}")
print(f"Saved: {png_path}")
